payload.coherence_check: Each finding is fixed on its own and none may undo another. A finding that no longer holds -- already fixed, or misread by the finder -- is left alone, and the build says so.

health_findings.claim: Three of SL-043's settled rules repeat twinned entries in the same file: 'the classifier does not list link tags', 'nothing in Core waits on the volume figure' and 'the volume read cannot hold a scan's memory' have the same patterns and scopes as TheClassifierListsNoLinkTags, NothingWaitsOnTheVolumeFigure (Core) and TheVolumeReadHoldsNoScanStore. Every violation is therefore reported twice. One copy also states the opposite of the rule next to it: its reason says 'The App may wait on it because it does so on its own thread, and it is outside this glob'. The twinned App entry and the xUnit Fact forbid exactly that (SL-043 M1). An editor who trusts the settled text could relax the App rule.
